Title: Lots of questions - Revelations, Shambling Hordes, Rotschreck ....

Messages.Author: Mirko Marinkovic
Messages.Body:
Hi All,

1) When player looks at prays hand using Revelations, and then
discards a card, can he also see which card is drawn to replace it?

2)
a)When a vampire is in combat with Shambling Hordes and steals blood
with Theft Of Vitae does Hordes strike with 2 hand damage or 4 hand
damage?
b)Same as above, but when vampire strikes with a first strike for 2
damage?

3)Some Rotschreck questions:
a) When acting vampire plays Majesty and blocking vampire plays agr
damage and Rotschreck, does acting vampire goes to torpor untapped?
b) Can Rotschreck be played after acting vampire prevents aggravated
damage?

4)
a)When minion equips with Helicopter using Magic Of The Smith, does
Helicopter enters tapped or untapped?
b)Same question, but when vampire equips using Alastor?

5)When vampire equipped with Aaron's Feeding Razor while Restricted
Vitae is in play hunts by stealing blood from a younger vampire does
he steals 2 blood and gains 2 blood or he steals one blood but gains
2?

Thank You and excuse my bad english

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jan 19, 2:14 pm, Mirko Marinkovic <edger2...@gmail.com> wrote:
> 1) When player looks at prays hand using Revelations, and then
> discards a card, can he also see which card is drawn to replace it?

No.

> 2)
> a)When a vampire is in combat with Shambling Hordes and steals blood
> with Theft Of Vitae does Hordes strike with 2 hand damage or 4 hand
> damage?

4, assuming the Hordes had four life when striking.

> b)Same as above, but when vampire strikes with a first strike for 2
> damage?

2, assuming the Hordes has 2 life when striking (i.e., after handling
the strike for 2 damage).

> 3)Some Rotschreck questions:
> a) When acting vampire plays Majesty and blocking vampire plays agr
> damage and Rotschreck, does acting vampire goes to torpor untapped?

No. Rötschreck ends combat when played, before moving to strike
resolution.

> b) Can Rotschreck be played after acting vampire prevents aggravated
> damage?

It cannot be played during strike resolution, no.

> 4)
> a)When minion equips with Helicopter using Magic Of The Smith, does
> Helicopter enters tapped or untapped?

Card text: tapped.

> b)Same question, but when vampire equips using Alastor?

Untapped. (Alastor doesn't "equip", which is also why you don't need
to meet the requirements)

> 5)When vampire equipped with Aaron's Feeding Razor while Restricted
> Vitae is in play hunts by stealing blood from a younger vampire does
> he steals 2 blood and gains 2 blood or he steals one blood but gains
> 2?

He steals two.
